subject: Add AI layer: Claude chat, session logging, SCP transfers, host-call protocol, Windows agent
body:
Add AI layer: Claude chat, session logging, SCP transfers, host-call protocol, Windows agent

- ClaudeChatWindow: dockable Claude API chat panel with cgo command parsing
- SessionLogWindow: searchable browser for PuTTY session logs
- ScpTransferWindow: progress panel for SCP file transfers
- HostCall protocol: <<host-call><action>payload>> tags trigger local SCP ops
- SessionLogRegistry: maps log paths to ConnectionInfo for host-call routing
- PuttyBase: auto-attaches -sessionlog arg to every SSH/Telnet session
- ConnectionTab: Paste + Freeze & Copy toolbar, drag-drop SCP upload
- windows-agent/poller.py: Windows-side task runner for Mac Claude → Windows bridge

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Personal AI-layer experiment (Claude chat panel, SendKeys command injection, API keys in settings). Out of scope, large attack surface, no user demand in our tracker.
